messages:
anya: @channel Quick notice: launching the 'DocShip' checklist + Compatibility Corridor policy today. Cliff notes: 90-day compatibility guarantee for managed SDK minor releases, 180 days for Private installs, migration-template required for release PRs.

sam: thanks! where's the checklist?

anya: draft here: https://redwood.internal/docs/docship. It includes migration guide template, minimal rollback recipe, QA prompt set, and consumer messaging copy.

lee: can we automate the QA run on canary? Platform should gate releases on that.

infra-bot: infra task created: JOB-1150 to add canary QA job.

anya: agreed. SDK owners should add the QA runner to CI. Also: telemetry for compat events is opt-in only (field: compat_reporting_enabled) and will be reviewed by security.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/prs/5101 with migration template attached.

sam: timeline?

anya: DocShip usable now (draft). Policy effective next Monday; we'll pilot with JS SDK canary this week. Leave a note on the PR if you're contributing.
